description: Modal dialog for importing an email template from MJML or JSON, via pasted text or a dropped file. Shows parse errors or a summary preview (section and warning counts) and confirms the import into the editor.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is closed.

parameters.name: OnImport
parameters.description: Raised with the imported document when the user confirms.

parameters.name: ImportOptions
parameters.description: The limits applied to the input (D13): MaxInputBytes is measured in UTF-8 bytes and bounds both the pasted text and the read file; the section/block/depth limits go to the importer and the JSON deserializer. null means the contract defaults (5 MB, 200 sections, 2000 blocks, nesting 8).

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the dialog renders in — the editor's already resolved mode, so a phone gets the core sheet with the sticky footer (F2) without a second measurement.
